title: CORS: Allow Other Sites to Call Your APIs | Orchard Core
description:
A browser lets a web page read a response from another site only when that site agrees. Without a CORS policy, a partner site or a separate front end cannot call the APIs of your Orchard Core site from a browser.

The CORS Configuration feature lets you define policies: the origins, methods, and headers you allow, with one default policy for the site. The admin refuses to save the unsafe combination of any origin with credentials.

In this video:
• How origins, CORS headers, and browsers work together
• Enabling the CORS Configuration feature and opening its page
• Creating a policy with credentials, origins, headers, and methods
• The unsafe combination that the admin refuses to save
• Settings to keep narrow, and what to check when a browser blocks a call
